title: DeckView — Zoomed-out Deck Views
description:
Zooms out deck-like views so the whole deck is visible at a glance. Mini-cards shrink the deck view, draw/discard/exhaust piles, card library, and deck card-select screens; hovering a card pops it back to full size.

Left at normal size: the combat hand, the inspect popup, and the choose-a-card, card-reward, unlock, shop, and card-bundle screens.

Visibility only: DeckView does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay.

Toggle any time with the on-screen Mini-cards tickbox or press T; the choice persists across runs. Mouse, keyboard, and controller supported.

(The whole-act map view that older DeckView builds bundled is now the separate One-Page Map mod.)

Targets STS2 v0.110.1.
changeNote: Description update: the map view is now the separate One-Page Map mod (formerly FlatMap).
